    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    points.sort()
    dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
    dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
    if dr == 0 and dc == 0:
        return out
    # Extend the regularly spaced diagonal/line of markers using color 2.
    r, c = points[-1]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    while 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
